title: Vibrant Green Australian Asparagus Frittata
description: A winey and crumbly Australian brunch dish featuring asparagus, infused oil, and macrobiotic friendly ingredients, perfect for a relaxing morning meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Heat the infused olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the asparagus to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Pour the whisked eggs over the asparagus and tomatoes in the skillet.
Sprinkle the crumbly feta cheese over the eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
